title: Moho skeleton and bones
description: A BoneLayer's (or SwitchLayer's) `skeleton` field. See docs/moho-project-file-format.md §9 for the deformation model (rigid vs flexible/region binding) and the module docstring's BONE DEFORMATION and SMART BONES sections.

binding_mode.description: Observed values: 1 (large majority), 2 (rare). Meaning not decoded; moho2svg.py never branches on it.

bones_groups.description: Observed only rarely, and empty in every sample seen. Presumably a bone-grouping feature parallel to mesh.groups.

Bone.description: One bone. A flat list (Skeleton.bones) - `parent` is an index into the SAME list, not a tree. Parents are not guaranteed to appear earlier in the list than their children. Every constraint/IK/physics/control field below (angle_control_*, pos_control_*, scale_control_*, ik_*, min/max_constraint, and every *_dynamics/*_force/physics_* field) is read by moho2svg.py in the sense that the document model exposes it, but NOT applied when rendering - see docs/moho-project-file-format.md §9 KNOWN GAPS. They matter only for posing live in the Moho editor; the resulting angle/position is already baked into anim_angle/anim_pos by the time the document is saved, EXCEPT for anim_parent, which can genuinely diverge from the static `parent` field (see below).

name.description: Also how a Smart Bone dial is matched: a bone counts as a dial if its own name appears in the enclosing BoneLayer's `actions` registry - see docs/moho-project-file-format.md §11.

parent.description: -1 for a root bone, otherwise an index into this same bones array.

length.description: In document units (2 units span the canvas height).

strength.description: Influence radius for flexible binding. 0 disables this bone's influence entirely, checked before any weight-falloff calculation - Moho's own "this bone does not deform this mesh" gate.

anim_pos.description: Animated position, relative to the parent bone.

anim_scale.description: A SINGLE, uniform scale (unlike a layer's transforms.scale, which is per-axis) - see Skeleton.world_matrices in the module docstring.

anim_parent.description: Animated reparenting: the value at each keyframe is a bone INDEX (or -1), letting a bone change parent mid-animation (the Reparent Bone tool). moho2svg.py uses the static `parent` field instead and ignores this - confirmed harmless in the reverse-engineering sample set only because every sampled anim_parent channel has exactly one keyframe whose value equals the bone's own static `parent` (zero mismatches across 550+ bones, including in a document created specifically to demonstrate the Reparent Bone tool) - a document that actually keyframes a mid-animation reparent would be rendered wrong.

scaling_mode.description: Observed values: 0, 2. Meaning not decoded; possibly related to the intentionally-preserved asymmetric bone scale in Skeleton.world_matrices (only the matrix's first column is scaled by anim_scale).

min_constraint.description: In radians. Only meaningful in the Moho editor while posing - the resulting angle is already baked into anim_angle.

target_bone.description: The Target Bone tool's own target reference.

angle_control_parent.description: Index into this same bones array (or -1). Observed non-trivial targets in bone-control-focused documents (e.g. ControlBones.animeproj, IndependentAngle.animeproj).
